## User problem

What are you trying to do, and what prevents it today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired outcome and the relevant App, CLI, SDK or tool entry point.
Include an example if helpful.

## Alternatives considered

Describe existing workarounds or other approaches.

## Scope and validation

Which model, device or platform is relevant? How would a contributor demonstrate
that the improvement works? Link related issues, design notes or experiments,
and distinguish proposed performance gains from measured results.
